userStories.title: Register a user
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to register with an email address so that I can manage my catalog account.
acceptanceCriteria: The service rejects registrations without an email address.
The service rejects an email address already assigned to another user.
A successful registration returns the new user identifier.

userStories.title: Browse products
userStories.description: As a customer, I want to browse products so that I can discover items available in the catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: The service returns products with their SKU, name, and price.
The service returns an empty collection when no products match the request.
